Read left column then right; page871 chapter heading explicitly classified. Every indented continuation grouped with exact raw text, source IDs and bboxes; no fixed row assumption. transcription_check.pair_review: All 1519 reconstructed source-English pairs read in order: eight blocks of150, then165 and154.
